subject: Vendor risk package: PioneerML insurance, questionnaire, and PO
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Contracts <contracts@pioneer-ml.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Required onboarding docs to finalize PO

Hi Ellen / PioneerML contracts team,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — excited to move forward. To complete vendor setup and issue a PO we need the standard risk package. Can you please provide the following by end of day Tuesday (US PST):

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) listing Redwood Inference, Inc. as additional insured and the following endorsement language: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents are included as additional insured";
- Completed vendor risk questionnaire (attached template is optional to use);
- Completed W-9 (or W-8 if applicable);
- Primary contact for invoicing and the billing remit address;
- Any subcontractor names if you plan to use third parties.

Attached are two helpful docs: onboarding_vendor_questionnaire.docx and coi_endorsement_guidance.pdf (these are templates; if your broker outputs a standard COI we can accept as long as endorsement language is present). Once we receive the COI and W-9, Finance will generate a PO and confirm payment terms (Net 30 unless otherwise agreed).

Next steps after you send docs:
1) We confirm COI matches our minimum limits and endorsement.
2) Procurement issues PO and sends PO number/DocuSign for signature.
3) You confirm receipt and start date for services.

If you expect any delays or need different insurer wording, flag it now and I can loop in legal.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
--
attachments: onboarding_vendor_questionnaire.docx (docx), coi_endorsement_guidance.pdf (pdf)

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@pioneer-ml.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@pioneer-ml.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Required onboarding docs to finalize PO

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick responses below and attaching what we have so far.

- COI: attached as "PioneerML_COI_2026-11-22.pdf". Our broker can add the endorsement language but asks whether Redwood has a required minimum for Cyber or Professional Liability in addition to GL/Auto. We currently carry: GL $1M / $2M agg, Auto $1M, Excess $5M, Professional Liability (E&O) $2M, Cyber insurance $1M.
- Vendor questionnaire: we completed your template, attached as "PioneerML_Vendor_RQ_2026-11-22.pdf".
- W-9: attached as "PioneerML_W9_2026-11-22.pdf".
- Billing contact: Ellen Park (ellen.park@pioneer-ml.com); remit: PioneerML, 4820 Harbor Ave, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92101.

A few asks from our side: can Redwood confirm whether the COI needs an "waiver of subrogation" endorsement and whether the additional insured needs to be primary and non-contributory? Those are standard with some of our customers and will speed issuance if we know the exact language.

Also, could you confirm expected PO numbering cadence and whether your PO holds for 60 days from issuance? We have a contract sig schedule and want to align invoicing.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Partnerships
PioneerML
--
attachments: PioneerML_COI_2026-11-22.pdf (pdf), PioneerML_Vendor_RQ_2026-11-22.pdf (pdf), PioneerML_W9_2026-11-22.pdf (pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Legal Intake <legal.intake@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: PioneerML docs — endorsement and subrogation question

Looping in legal to confirm endorsement requirements. Quote from vendor below.

On 2026-11-22 10:47, Ellen Park wrote:
> Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick responses below and attaching what we have so far.
> 
> - COI: attached as "PioneerML_COI_2026-11-22.pdf". Our broker can add the endorsement language but asks whether Redwood has a required minimum for Cyber or Professional Liability in addition to GL/Auto. We currently carry: GL $1M / $2M agg, Auto $1M, Excess $5M, Professional Liability (E&O) $2M, Cyber insurance $1M.
> - Vendor questionnaire: we completed your template, attached as "PioneerML_Vendor_RQ_2026-11-22.pdf".
> - W-9: attached as "PioneerML_W9_2026-11-22.pdf".
> - Billing contact: Ellen Park (ellen.park@pioneer-ml.com); remit: PioneerML, 4820 Harbor Ave, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92101.
> 
> A few asks from our side: can Redwood confirm whether the COI needs an "waiver of subrogation" endorsement and whether the additional insured needs to be primary and non-contributory?

Can Legal confirm:
- Do we require primary & non-contributory and waiver of subrogation for a services engagement under $250k ARR?
- Is E&O at $2M sufficient or do we require $5M for Professional Liability for prod-adjacent work?

If legal wants to escalate to procurement for contract negotiations we can pause PO issuance until endorsements are confirmed.

Thanks,
Hannah
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@pioneer-ml.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Required onboarding docs to finalize PO

Hi Sofia / Hannah — following up with final files attached. Broker processed an endorsement and added the additional insured wording requested. Please find the updated COI attached (PioneerML_COI_2026-11-24.pdf) along with a signed W-9 and the completed questionnaire.

We did not add a waiver of subrogation — our broker flagged that as uncommon for our policy structure; if Redwood requires it we can request but it will take extra time. Regarding primary & non-contributory: endorsement added reads "It is agreed that the insurance afforded the additional insured shall be primary and non-contributory to the insurance of the additional insured" per the carrier.

Next steps on your side: please confirm receipt and, if all looks good, issue a PO number and DocuSign link for the SOW/PO. We are ready to start onboarding once the PO is in place.

PO: Please send PO and billing/AR contact to ellen.park@pioneer-ml.com.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Partnerships
PioneerML
--
attachments: PioneerML_COI_2026-11-24.pdf (pdf), PioneerML_W9_2026-11-24.pdf (pdf), PioneerML_Vendor_RQ_2026-11-24.pdf (pdf)
